events.title: Man Detained After Married Couple Shot Dead in Tbilisi, Allegedly Amid Eviction Dispute
events.summary: The Ministry of Internal Affairs (MIA) detained one person after a married couple was shot dead near the elevator of a residential building in Tbilisi’s Didube district on the evening of November 11, reportedly amid a property dispute related to the planned eviction of the alleged suspect’s family.
